It is comprised of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago deep in the Stormy Sea, with no single administrative center. Rinascita was known as "Sepunia" in [[Version/Closed Beta I|CBT1]]. It was likely named after the obscure [[wp:Sepunia gens|Sepunia plebian family]] of ancient Rome, who are known from inscriptions and as municipal officers of towns in Latium, Samnium, and Campania in the core of the polity. === Etymology === * "Rinascita" is an {{w|Italian language|Italian}} word that means "rebirth".
